market_news.paragraph: Global equities were broadly firmer in the latest completed round of trading, with 19 of the 24 benchmarks tracked on this page closing higher. In the United States, the S&P 500 rose 0.66 per cent to 7,773.95, the Nasdaq Composite rose 1.05 per cent to 27,477 and the Russell 2000 rose 0.50 per cent to 2,847.14. In Europe, the FTSE 100 rose 0.34 per cent to 10,498, the DAX rose 0.09 per cent to 25,254 and the CAC 40 fell 0.80 per cent to 7,834.10. Across Asia, the Nikkei 225 rose 1.44 per cent to 69,947, the Hang Seng fell 2.33 per cent to 24,040, the KOSPI rose 0.46 per cent to 7,003.74, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.31 per cent to 3,842.20, the BSE Sensex fell 0.13 per cent to 72,382 and the Straits Times fell 0.06 per cent to 5,664.33. Elsewhere, the Ibovespa rose 7.70 per cent to 206,912. Locally, the S&P/ASX 200 rose 0.05 per cent to 8,686.40 and the All Ordinaries rose 0.05 per cent to 8,859.20. In digital assets, bitcoin changed hands at $85,797, down 0.01 per cent over the past 24 hours. In currencies, the US dollar bought 1.4367 Australian dollars, down 0.31 per cent against the prior business day's fix. Index levels, exchange rates and commodity prices on this page are captured live at build time from the sources linked in each section; no forward-looking view is offered here.
